name: [IMPACT] Striker Odyssey
desc:
Nothing should bring you more joy than your own goals. Live only for that glorious moment. And if you can’t…then you’re no striker at all.

CONTROLS
M - Menu
N - Emotes
LMB - Shoot/Use Skill
RMB - Take The Ball From Other Player
Q - Tackle
E - Pass
R - Header
T - Lob Pass
F - Heel Pass
B - Switch Skill Direction (Optional in settings)
H - Pass Ping
Z,C,X,V - Dribbling Left,Right,Back, Forward

SHIFT - Run
ALT - Shiftlock

PC/Mobile support
